_comment: Golden dataset for prompt evaluation (28-ai-platform.md, T120). Each case is a closed evidence set recorded from a real pipeline run over the M2.0 baseline scenario — not hand-written, so every fact traces back to a simulated provider payload and the id the pipeline minted for it. `load_bearing` names the facts a narrative must cite to be useful; coverage is measured against them. `fingerprint` is the SHA-256 of `cases`: editing an expectation without bumping `version` fails to load, because a result recorded against version 1 must remain re-measurable against version 1. Regenerate with `python -m tests.ai_platform.seed_golden_dataset`, review the diff, and bump the version if any case changed.
